Cooper prioritises public health, domestic abuse and care workforce

Health secretary Yvette Cooper has announced the full return of 'Sure Start' to community family hubs over the next two years, new specialist domestic abuse services and a "proper" workforce plan for social care.
Sure Start will be rolled out to 1,000 hubs by 2028, alongside a £50m investment in new services that refer domestic abuse victims to support.
The Department of Health and Social Care will also publish a "proper" workforce plan for social care, which Ms Cooper suggested would contain promises to offer more career development pathways for staff.
The health and social care secretary told conference attendees in Liverpool that the reforms were part of a wider vision to "bring together health and social care" and firmly set the NHS on a "path to recovery".
